title: Very Sweet and Nutty Syrian Dates Tagine
description: A rich and flavorful dessert featuring desiccated coconut and shio-koji-cured dates. This vegan-friendly tagine is perfect for satisfying late-night cravings.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the desiccated coconut, shio-koji, and a pinch of salt.
Stuff each date with a small amount of the coconut-shio-koji mixture.
In a scallop-shell vessel, arrange the stuffed dates in a single layer.
Drizzle the melted coconut oil over the dates, followed by the maple syrup.
Sprinkle the vanilla extract, cinnamon, and nutmeg evenly over the dates.
Cover the vessel with a lid or foil and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 10-12 minutes, or until the dates are tender and caramelized.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
